description: Fetch full detail for a specific CVE by ID. Read-only. No side effects. Idempotent. cve_id: CVE identifier in format CVE-YYYY-NNNNN e.g. CVE-2021-44228. Required. Returns description, CVSS base score, affected products, patch references, and publish date. Use this when you have a CVE ID and need complete detail beyond what a package scan returns. Use security_fetch_package_vulnerabilities instead when you want all CVEs for a package version. Verified source: NIST NVD. 1-hour cache. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_fetch_cve_detail", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".
name: security_fetch_cve_detail
title: Security Fetch Cve Detail
